body: Hexapod with chelicerae, array of infrared pit organs, and dark lens eyes

links: Prey creates polarization artifacts against background
Thin atmosphere preserves high-contrast polarization patterns

skill.effect: Player can reveal hidden targets by detecting polarization contrast; 0.85 contrast reveal radius.

chains.weakness: Blind to UV and color cues; relies entirely on polarization geometry.
observe: Pit organs twitch continuously, tracking sky polarization angle
Eyes are dark lenses with no color receptors
Strike direction aligns with polarization vector line

journal.en: A jagged stone that reads the sky's invisible lines.

plausibility.summary: Rename to polarization-specialized dorsal eyes or ommatidial bands; reserve pit organs for IR (prey thermogram on cold salt, fumarole contrast). Hunting ‘the gap’ stays—eyes read e-vector mismatch, pits confirm warm body at strike.
fixes: Rename to polarization-specialized dorsal eyes or ommatidial bands; reserve pit organs for IR (prey thermogram on cold salt, fumarole contrast). Hunting ‘the gap’ stays—eyes read e-vector mismatch, pits confirm warm body at strike.

analogues.organism: Stomatopod/mantis shrimp polarization ommatidia (not pits); honeybee polarization sky compass in retina; pit viper IR pits for thermal targeting only (Gracheva et al.).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: High UV flux damages polarization-sensitive tissue

skill.effect: Player gains passive UV resistance when befriending Crisol.

chains.weakness: Cannot see UV flares or UV-camouflaged prey that lacks polarization artifact.
observe: Pit organs have dark, opaque covers

journal.en: It blocks the sun to see the world's true angles.

plausibility.summary: If polarization moves to eyes, apply UV filters to both eye regions and pit covers; note flares scramble polarization (behavioral retreat) more than IR baseline from M-dwarf NIR (F2).

analogues.organism: Pigmented facial scales over pit viper fossae; arthropod corneal screening pigments in high-UV deserts.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Predation requires speed to catch agile prey

skill.effect: Player can perform a 15m leap strike; covers distance instantly.

chains.weakness: Strike leaves predictable trajectory; prey can dodge with lateral motion.
observe: Launch leaves no sound, only displacement
Crisol misjudges if polarization vector is ambiguous

journal.en: A spring coiled in the silence.

plausibility.summary: Reframe Pounce as ~1–3 m curved lunge or strike from shale outcrop (horizontal+vertical), or ‘15 m’ as engagement range including stalking, not a single ballistic leap.
fixes: Reframe Pounce as ~1–3 m curved lunge or strike from shale outcrop (horizontal+vertical), or ‘15 m’ as engagement range including stalking, not a single ballistic leap.

analogues.organism: Trap-jaw ants (Odontomachus); fast-strike mantids and mantis shrimp; salticid jump attacks (short range).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

skill.effect: Player can heal by resting near fumaroles; 10 HP/turn.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable while roosting; flares can overwhelm sensory array.
observe: Crisol sits motionless over steam vents
Moves sluggishly when away from heat

journal.en: It drinks the earth's breath to power its strike.

plausibility.summary: F12 active fumaroles and F20 arid heat budget give reliable microthermal hotspots; an ectothermic ambush predator gains strike-ready muscle temperature假体 while minimizing time exposed on cold salt. Vulnerability while roosting and flare-induced sensory overload are honest tradeoffs.

analogues.organism: Basking snakes and lizards on sun-warmed rock; insects on volcanic soil thermals; desert scorpions at burrow mouths.

relations.note: (council kind 'Prey of') Salaris is the primary prey of Crisol; its UV camouflage forces Crisol to rely on polarization hunting.
(council kind 'Hunter of') Crisol exploits Salaris's polarization artifact; a player using a polarizing filter can bypass the Crisol's gaze.

secrets: Crisol's pit organs overheat during prolonged tracking, glowing faintly in the thermal band.
A polarizing filter held by the player will render them invisible to Crisol's polarization sight.
moments: The Crisol waits motionless for an hour, its pits tracking the sky's polarization line. When the Salaris steps onto the crust, the predator does not look at the prey; it looks at the gap in the sky's polarization, and strikes through the blind spot.

journal.en: Crisol hunts the gap between the stone and the sky.
The predator sees the angle, not the flesh.
